slides.title: continue Statement Function
slides.prompt: What does 'continue' do inside a loop?
options: Skips the remainder of the current iteration and jumps to next iteration

options: It creates unstructured 'spaghetti code' that is hard to follow and debug
It is deprecated and won't compile

slides.prompt: When 'break' is executed inside a nested loop, which loop does it terminate?
options: Only the innermost loop containing the break
slides.correctAnswer: Only the innermost loop containing the break

slides.title: return Statement Function
slides.prompt: How does 'return' differ from 'break' inside a loop function?
options: 'return' exits the entire function immediately, while 'break' only exits the current loop
slides.correctAnswer: 'return' exits the entire function immediately, while 'break' only exits the current loop
